name: Asset Manager Application

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage - Web Module
incidents.message: Application uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13) which needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage
incidents.description: The web module uses AWS S3 Client for object storage operations. This needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage SDK.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update all S3Client usages to BlobServiceClient.

incidents.title: AWS S3 Service Implementation
incidents.message: AwsS3Service implements storage operations using AWS S3 SDK
incidents.description: Service class with S3Client dependency that performs upload, download, list, and delete operations.
incidents.recommendation: Create Azure Blob Storage equivalent service using BlobServiceClient and BlobContainerClient

incidents.title: AWS S3 Configuration
incidents.message: AWS S3 configuration with hard-coded credentials pattern
incidents.description: Configuration file sets up S3Client with region and credentials
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure configuration using DefaultAzureCredential for managed identity authentication

incidents.title: S3 PutObject Operations
incidents.message: Uses AWS S3 PutObjectRequest for file uploads
incidents.description: Upload functionality uses S3-specific API calls
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.upload() method from Azure Blob Storage SDK

incidents.title: S3 GetObject Operations
incidents.message: Uses AWS S3 GetObjectRequest for file downloads
incidents.description: Download functionality uses S3-specific API calls
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.downloadStream() method from Azure Blob Storage SDK

incidents.title: S3 DeleteObject Operations
incidents.message: Uses AWS S3 DeleteObjectRequest for file deletion
incidents.description: Delete functionality uses S3-specific API calls
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.delete() method from Azure Blob Storage SDK

incidents.title: S3 ListObjects Operations
incidents.message: Uses AWS S3 ListObjectsV2Request for listing files
incidents.description: List functionality uses S3-specific API calls
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobContainerClient.listBlobs() method from Azure Blob Storage SDK

incidents.title: S3 URL Generation
incidents.message: Uses AWS S3 GetUrlRequest for generating object URLs
incidents.description: URL generation uses S3-specific utilities
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.getBlobUrl() method from Azure Blob Storage SDK

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK Usage - Worker Module
incidents.message: Worker module uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13)
incidents.description: The worker module also uses AWS S3 Client for thumbnail processing operations
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage SDK in worker module as well

incidents.title: AWS S3 Service - Worker Module
incidents.message: Worker module has S3FileProcessingService with S3 dependencies
incidents.description: Service class for processing images from S3 storage
incidents.recommendation: Create Azure Blob equivalent service for worker module

incidents.title: AWS S3 Configuration - Worker Module
incidents.message: Worker module has AWS S3 configuration
incidents.description: Configuration for S3Client in worker module
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure configuration in worker module

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Messaging Infrastructure
incidents.message: Application uses RabbitMQ (spring-boot-starter-amqp) for message queue
incidents.description: Both web and worker modules use RabbitMQ for asynchronous image processing communication
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Service Bus using Spring Cloud Azure Service Bus Starter (com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus)

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Configuration
incidents.message: RabbitConfig configures RabbitMQ queue and message converters
incidents.description: Configuration class for RabbitMQ infrastructure
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus configuration

incidents.title: RabbitTemplate Usage
incidents.message: Uses RabbitTemplate for sending messages
incidents.description: Message sending using RabbitMQ specific template
incidents.recommendation: Replace with ServiceBusSenderClient from Azure Service Bus SDK

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Queue Declaration
incidents.message: Declares RabbitMQ queue 'image-processing'
incidents.description: Queue configuration for message processing
incidents.recommendation: Create equivalent Azure Service Bus queue

incidents.title: Message Converter Configuration
incidents.message: Uses Jackson2JsonMessageConverter for RabbitMQ messages
incidents.description: JSON message serialization for RabbitMQ
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus has built-in JSON support, adjust accordingly

incidents.title: Manual Acknowledgment Mode
incidents.message: Configured with manual acknowledgment mode
incidents.description: Custom acknowledgment configuration for RabbitMQ
incidents.recommendation: Configure Azure Service Bus message settlement modes appropriately

incidents.title: Message Publishing
incidents.message: Publishes messages using convertAndSend
incidents.description: Message publishing pattern in upload workflow
incidents.recommendation: Use ServiceBusSenderClient.sendMessage() for Azure Service Bus

incidents.title: RabbitMQ in Worker Module
incidents.message: Worker module depends on spring-boot-starter-amqp
incidents.description: Worker uses RabbitMQ for message consumption
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus starter in worker module

incidents.title: Message Listener Pattern
incidents.message: Worker likely uses @RabbitListener for message consumption
incidents.description: Message consumption pattern needs migration
incidents.recommendation: Replace with @ServiceBusListener from Spring Cloud Azure

incidents.title: Hard-coded AWS Credentials
incidents.message: AWS access keys are configured in plain text properties file
incidents.description: Credentials stored in application.properties without encryption
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) for passwordless authentication. Remove hard-coded credentials.

incidents.title: Hard-coded AWS Credentials - Worker
incidents.message: AWS credentials in worker module application.properties
incidents.description: Worker module also has hard-coded credentials
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity for worker module as well

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Password
incidents.message: RabbitMQ password in plain text
incidents.description: Message broker credentials stored insecurely
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault to store sensitive configuration or rely on managed identity for Azure Service Bus

incidents.title: Database Password
incidents.message: PostgreSQL password in plain text
incidents.description: Database credentials stored insecurely
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault or Azure App Configuration to store database credentials securely

incidents.title: PostgreSQL Database
incidents.message: Application uses PostgreSQL database
incidents.description: Database configuration points to PostgreSQL instance
incidents.recommendation: Consider migrating to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Update connection string to use Azure endpoint.

incidents.title: Hibernate DDL Auto Update
incidents.message: Using ddl-auto=update in production configuration
incidents.description: Automatic schema updates may not be ideal for production
incidents.recommendation: Use proper database migration tools like Flyway or Liquibase for production deployments

incidents.title: Spring Boot Version
incidents.message: Using Spring Boot 3.2.1
incidents.description: Application uses Spring Boot 3.2.1 which may not be the latest stable version
incidents.recommendation: Consider upgrading to the latest Spring Boot 3.x version for better Azure integration and latest features

incidents.title: Profile-based Service Selection
incidents.message: Uses Spring profiles for service selection
incidents.description: AwsS3Service is active when not in 'dev' profile
incidents.recommendation: Ensure proper profile configuration for Azure environments (e.g., 'azure' profile)

incidents.title: Local File Storage Fallback
incidents.message: Application has LocalFileStorageService for dev profile
incidents.description: Local file storage implementation for development
incidents.recommendation: Ensure Azure Blob Storage service works properly in all environments. Keep local storage for dev/test only.

incidents.title: S3-specific Model Classes
incidents.message: S3StorageItem model class references S3 specifically
incidents.description: Data model tied to AWS S3 naming
incidents.recommendation: Rename to generic 'StorageItem' or 'BlobStorageItem' to be cloud-agnostic

incidents.title: S3-specific Metadata Fields
incidents.message: ImageMetadata has S3-specific field names (s3Key, s3Url)
incidents.description: Database model uses S3-specific naming
incidents.recommendation: Rename fields to be cloud-agnostic (storageKey, storageUrl) or create Azure-specific fields

incidents.title: Multi-module Maven Project
incidents.message: Project has web and worker modules
incidents.description: Multi-module structure requires coordinated migration
incidents.recommendation: Ensure both modules are migrated consistently. Consider Azure-specific deployment architecture (App Service + Container Apps or Functions).

incidents.title: Lombok Usage
incidents.message: Project uses Lombok for code generation
incidents.description: Lombok dependency present in both modules
incidents.recommendation: Lombok is compatible with Azure. No changes needed.

incidents.title: No Application Insights Integration
incidents.message: No Azure Application Insights dependency found
incidents.description: Application lacks Azure-native monitoring and telemetry
incidents.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights for monitoring and diagnostics: com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-spring-boot-starter

recommendations.title: Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
recommendations.description: Replace all AWS S3 SDK dependencies and implementations with Azure Blob Storage SDK. This includes both web and worker modules.
tasks: Replace AWS S3 SDK dependency with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob)
Update AwsS3Service to AzureBlobService using BlobServiceClient
Replace all S3-specific API calls (PutObject, GetObject, DeleteObject, ListObjects) with Azure Blob equivalents
Update worker module S3FileProcessingService to use Azure Blob Storage
Configure Azure Blob Storage connection using DefaultAzureCredential
Update configuration files to use Azure Storage account settings
Rename S3-specific model classes and fields to be cloud-agnostic

recommendations.title: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ messaging infrastructure with Azure Service Bus for reliable cloud-native messaging.
tasks: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus
Update RabbitConfig to Azure Service Bus configuration
Replace RabbitTemplate with ServiceBusSenderClient
Update message listeners to use @ServiceBusListener
Configure Azure Service Bus connection using DefaultAzureCredential
Create Azure Service Bus queue equivalent to 'image-processing'
Test message sending and receiving with Azure Service Bus

recommendations.title: Implement Managed Identity Authentication
recommendations.description: Remove hard-coded credentials and implement Azure Managed Identity for passwordless authentication.
tasks: Remove hard-coded AWS credentials from configuration files
Implement DefaultAzureCredential for Azure Blob Storage authentication
Implement DefaultAzureCredential for Azure Service Bus authentication
Move database credentials to Azure Key Vault or Azure App Configuration
Configure managed identity in Azure deployment
Update documentation with security best practices

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Migrate from self-hosted PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL for better management and scaling.
tasks: Provision Azure Database for PostgreSQL
Update JDBC connection string to Azure endpoint
Configure firewall rules and virtual network integration
Test database connectivity
Implement proper database migration strategy (Flyway/Liquibase)

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Integrate Azure Application Insights for comprehensive monitoring and diagnostics.
tasks: Add Application Insights Spring Boot starter dependency
Configure Application Insights connection string
Add custom telemetry where needed
Test monitoring dashboard and alerts

recommendations.title: Upgrade Spring Boot Version
recommendations.description: Upgrade to the latest Spring Boot 3.x version for improved Azure integration and latest features.
tasks: Upgrade Spring Boot to latest 3.x version
Test application compatibility
Update any deprecated APIs
Verify all Azure integrations work correctly

blockers: AWS S3 storage migration requires data migration strategy
RabbitMQ to Service Bus migration requires message format compatibility testing
Credentials management needs Azure infrastructure setup
